strings.About_Usage_Intro: The sidebar is ordered 账号管理 → account verification → login → history → cached accounts → loadout → personalization → toolbox → settings. Follow the flow or jump straight to a page.
strings.About_Usage_Update: Auto update | Check for new builds on the About page: same version is reported plainly, a mismatch highlights Download Update - nothing downloads until you click it, and the installer is deleted after a successful install. Network failures tell you to use a VPN or download from the Releases page.
strings.About_Usage_Security: Credential security | EYA tokens, account passwords, mobile 2FA secrets and email passwords are stored with AES-256-GCM + DPAPI (bound to the current user and PC) by default, with no passphrase required; you can add an optional passphrase (layer 4). The data folder cannot be decrypted on another PC or user account.
strings.About_Usage_NaiweiNote: ★ Adapted to 奶味验号.xyz: the verification module takes a redeem code and shows account status, competitive records and the game library - then logs in with one click.
strings.About_Usage_Loadout: Loadout | Drag-and-drop T/CT weapon presets saved per account; applied automatically on login or with one click on the login page.
strings.About_Usage_Login: Login | Token (SteamID + JWT), legacy EYA, auto, manual and credentials modes; fetch a name with a redeem code first if you like, then apply a loadout and clear Workshop subscriptions after signing in. Steam path comes from Settings.
strings.About_Usage_Workshop: Cleanup | Clear the current account's Workshop subscriptions from the Legacy EYA login page.
strings.About_Usage_ManagedAccounts: Accounts | Manage white accounts: name, password, status, notes and availability; import by password (exchanges account+password for an EYA token, auto-passes mobile 2FA), search, group, batch actions, export. Imported credentials are encrypted on disk automatically.
strings.About_Usage_CachedAccounts: Cached accounts | Lists the accounts Steam has cached on this PC and can restore one to the Steam sign-in screen (the login flow never clears your Steam account cache).
strings.About_Usage_TreasureBox: Toolbox | Extra tools and easter eggs: the classified card, one-click 18-digit UID, official-site lookup (Rage / Semirage / Legit) and a proxy recommendation.
strings.About_Usage_Query: Verification | Talks to 奶味验号.xyz (formerly xn--rpr1ku6kjs6f.xyz): enter a redeem code to read 8 status fields (Prime, profile level, service medal, cooldown, GC VAC, ...), competitive records and the game library, then fetch the name and sign in directly.
strings.About_Usage_History: History | Records every account you signed in with or checked; the detail pane shows JWT expiry, last login, competitive score, rank, cooldown and whether CS2 is the China build. Batch query, groups, export, copy token and quick re-login are supported.
strings.About_Usage_Personalize: Personalization | Set nickname, avatar and summary, then apply them to the signed-in account with one click; empty fields stay untouched.
strings.About_Usage_Settings: Settings | Language, light/dark/custom theme, accent color, background image, intro video, window size, Steam path, data folder, update source - plus an optional passphrase for local credentials.

strings.Settings_VaultPw_Desc: Off by default. When enabled, the locally stored EYA tokens, account passwords and mobile 2FA secrets get one more passphrase layer on top of the existing three. The passphrase stays in memory and is never written to disk; if you forget it the data cannot be recovered (you would have to delete the credential store and import the accounts again). It only works on this PC and this Windows user account - moving the data folder elsewhere makes it undecryptable even with the passphrase. Once enabled you must enter it at every launch to read accounts.
strings.Settings_VaultPw_Status_Off: Status: no passphrase (the three layers are always active and decryption is automatic).
strings.Settings_VaultPw_Status_On: Status: passphrase enabled, unlocked for this session.
strings.Settings_VaultPw_Status_Locked: Status: passphrase enabled, locked (the account list is not readable right now).
strings.VaultPw_Set_Desc: The passphrase is kept in memory only and is never written to any file. Please memorise it: a forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered. Backing up the data folder first is recommended.
strings.VaultPw_Confirm_Desc: Repeat the same passphrase to confirm.
strings.VaultPw_Change_Desc: Enter the new passphrase; the old one stops working immediately.
strings.VaultPw_Clear_Desc: Enter the current passphrase to confirm. Removing it restores automatic decryption; the original three layers stay in place.
strings.VaultPw_Unlock_Desc: This credential store is protected by a passphrase. Enter it to read the accounts. Cancel to skip loading accounts this time (you can unlock later in Settings).
strings.VaultPw_Error_TooShort: The passphrase must be at least 8 characters.
strings.VaultPw_Error_Mismatch: The two passphrases do not match.
strings.VaultPw_Status_SetOk: The credential passphrase is now active (it will be required at the next launch).
strings.VaultPw_Status_ClearedOk: The credential passphrase was removed; automatic decryption is restored.
strings.VaultPw_Status_LockedHint: The credential vault is locked; the account list is unavailable (enter the passphrase in Settings).
strings.Account_Error_HistoryFileUnreadable: The account history file is temporarily unavailable. It may be in use by antivirus software or cloud synchronization. This operation has been canceled, and no data has been changed. Please try again later.
strings.Workshop_Progress_GettingSubscriptions: Getting the list of subscribed Workshop items...
strings.Workshop_Error_RedirectNoLocation: Steam returned a redirect response without a target URL. The session may have expired. Please sign in again.
strings.Workshop_Error_TooManyRedirects: Steam returned too many redirects. The session may have expired. Please sign in again.
strings.Workshop_Error_RedirectedExternal: The session may have expired or the token may have been rejected, as Steam redirected to an external URL. Please sign in again.
strings.Cm_Error_TokenRevoked: The EYA token was rejected by Steam and may have been manually revoked.
strings.Cm_Error_TokenExpired: The EYA token has expired according to Steam.
strings.Cm_Error_TokenRejected: The EYA token was rejected by Steam and may have been revoked or become invalid.
strings.Cm_Error_CannotConnect_Format: Unable to connect to the Steam server. {0}
strings.Cm_Error_GetAccessTokenFailed: Failed to get the web access token
strings.Cm_Error_AccessTokenEmpty: The web access token returned by Steam is empty.
strings.Cm_Error_DuplicateGcWaiter: A wait operation for the same GC message already exists.
strings.Cm_Error_RequestQueueFailed: Failed to create the Steam request queue.
strings.Cm_Error_ServerListMalformed: The Steam CM server list response is malformed.
strings.Cm_Error_NoWebSocketServers: Steam did not return any available WebSocket CM servers.
strings.Cm_Error_ConnectTimeout_Format: The connection to Steam CM {0} timed out.
strings.Cm_Error_ConnectionClosed: The Steam CM connection has been closed.
strings.Cm_Error_NonProtobufLogon: Steam CM returned a non-protobuf logon response.
strings.Cm_Error_SessionReplaced: The Steam CM connection was superseded. This account may currently be active in the Steam client or CS2. Please fully exit CS2 and Steam, then perform the operation again in SteamEYA.
strings.Cm_Error_AccountLoggedOff: The Steam account has been logged off.
strings.License_Error_InvalidKeyOrServer: The license key is invalid or the wrong upstream server was selected.
strings.License_Error_WrongKeyOrServer: The license key is incorrect or the wrong upstream server was selected.
strings.License_Error_ResponseTooShort: The upstream server returned a response that is too short.
strings.License_Error_NoAccountData: The upstream JSON contains no account data.
strings.License_Error_MissingField_Format: The upstream JSON is missing a field: {0}
strings.License_Error_EmptyField_Format: The upstream JSON field is empty: {0}
strings.Jwt_Status_MissingSteamId: The EYA token is missing a SteamID.
strings.Jwt_Status_MissingExpiry: The EYA token is missing an expiry time.
strings.Jwt_Status_BadFormat: The EYA token format is invalid.
strings.Jwt_Status_Unparseable: The EYA token could not be processed.
strings.Jwt_Status_NotSteamToken: The EYA token is not a Steam token.
strings.Jwt_Status_MissingClientAudience: The EYA token is missing the client audience.
strings.Jwt_Status_EmptySteamId: The SteamID in the EYA token is empty.
strings.Jwt_Status_ExpiryUnparseable: The EYA token expiry time could not be processed.
strings.Jwt_Status_NotYetValid: The EYA token is not yet valid.
strings.Cs_Premier_BadSteam64: Invalid Steam64 ID; cannot fetch premier rank.
strings.Cs_Premier_NoProfile: The CS2 GC did not return an account profile.
strings.Cs_Loadout_Busy: A loadout task is already running. Please wait until it has finished, then try again.
strings.Cs_Loadout_CancelledAfterSend: The loadout request was already sent; stopped waiting for confirmation. Check the in-game loadout for the actual result.
strings.Cs_Loadout_BadSteam64: Invalid Steam64 ID; cannot modify the loadout.
strings.Cs_Loadout_CmDisconnected: The Steam CM connection was disconnected. Try fully exiting CS2 and Steam first, then apply the loadout in SteamEYA.
strings.Cs_Gc_ConnectTimeout: Connection timed out to the CS2 Game Coordinator.
strings.Login_Action_ClearWorkshop: Unsubscribe from all CS2 Workshop items
strings.Login_Btn_Personalize_Tip: Set this account's profile to the nickname, profile info and avatar saved on the Personalize page
strings.Login_Personalize_Empty: No personalization set. Add a nickname, profile info or avatar on the Personalize page first.
strings.Personalization_Subtitle: Set a nickname, profile info and avatar to apply to the current account from the login page. Fields left empty stay unchanged.
strings.Personalization_RealName_Placeholder: Enter the real name to set
strings.Personalization_Summary_Placeholder: Enter the profile summary to set; multiple lines supported
strings.Personalization_AvatarSaved: Avatar saved. Apply it with the Personalize button on the login page.
strings.Personalization_ImageLoadFailed: Couldn't load that image. Try another.
strings.Personalization_Alias_Desc: Steam keeps a public record of the nicknames this account has used, visible on the profile page. When checked, this record is cleared automatically each time Personalize finishes.
strings.Profile_Error_CurrentProfileUnavailable: Couldn't read the current profile; skipped saving to avoid blanking the nickname. Set a nickname or try again later.
strings.Profile_Error_ProfileSessionRejected: Couldn't save profile: session rejected (token may be invalid).
strings.Profile_Error_AliasSessionRejected: Couldn't clear name history: session rejected (token may be invalid).
strings.Profile_Error_AliasRejected: Steam rejected the request to clear name history.
strings.Profile_Error_AvatarSessionRejected: Avatar upload failed: session rejected (token may be invalid).
strings.Profile_Error_AvatarBadResponse: Couldn't parse Steam's response after uploading the avatar.
strings.Login_Status_SkippedOnlineValidation_For: Couldn't reach Steam's validation service; skipped online validation and continued to {0}.
strings.Loadout_Subtitle: Drag weapons from the pool below into the slots above; drag an equipped slot to reposition; click to remove. One loadout per account, saved automatically and applied from the Login page.
strings.Cs_Premier_CooldownUnknown: Cooldown status unknown (GC didn't respond; try again later)
strings.Update_EmptyResponse: GitHub Releases returned an empty response.
strings.Steam_Error_TokenEncryptFailed: Failed to encrypt the EYA token.
strings.Steam_Error_VdfAbort_Format: {0} could not be parsed; the write was aborted to avoid overwriting other Steam accounts' login cache. ({1})
strings.Steam_Error_VdfReadFailed_Format: Could not read {0}. The operation was stopped to avoid overwriting the existing Steam configuration. {1}
strings.Steam_Error_Vdf_TrailingContent: The VDF file contains extra content that could not be processed.
strings.Steam_Error_Vdf_MissingValue: A VDF key is missing its value.
strings.Steam_Error_Vdf_UnterminatedString: The VDF contains an unterminated quoted string.
strings.Cm_Proto_VarintTooLong: The protobuf varint is too long.
strings.Cm_Proto_WireTypeMismatch_Format: protobuf wire type mismatch: actual {0}, expected {1}.
strings.Settings_TableSeparator_Desc: Off by default. When enabled, separators can follow the theme or use a custom color.
strings.Settings_UiColor_Desc: Set the accent color. Enable automatic color change to rotate it once per second.
strings.AutoReport_Desc: Type 1-5 SteamID64s, pick the reporting account and the game (CS2 by default), then click Start: the app submits the whole queue as Cheating reports to the official Steam report endpoint in the background - no window is opened.
strings.AutoReport_Manual_Note: Only use it for accounts you are sure are cheating: reports are sent as the account you picked, and report spam can get that account restricted. Each result (success or failure reason) shows up in the queue below.
strings.AutoReport_Account_None: No usable account (needs account+password from managed accounts, or a token from history)
strings.AutoReport_Game_Search_Empty_Format: Steam store returned no game for {0}.
strings.AutoReport_Game_Search_Ok_Format: Found {0} game(s) on Steam - pick one from the drop-down.
strings.AutoReport_Ids_Tip: One per line, 17 digits; empty rows are skipped.
strings.AutoReport_Loop_Tip: Submit the whole queue this many times. Repeated reporting can be treated as abuse by Steam, so 2-10 rounds only.
strings.AutoReport_Status_NoAccount: No usable reporting account - add an account with a password or token first.
strings.AutoReport_Status_BuildingSession: Signing in to the Steam web with that account...
strings.AutoReport_Status_RateLimitStop: Steam is rate limiting this account: the run was stopped. Try again later.
strings.AutoReport_Status_Network_Fail_Format: Submit failed (cannot reach steamcommunity.com over TLS): {0}
strings.AutoReport_Status_Open_Fail_Format: Could not open the official report page: {0}
